name: Insurrection : 4 heures au Capitole (2021)
plot: Moins d’un an après cet événement inédit qui a sidéré le monde entier, un documentaire de Jamie Roberts nous replonge pendant au cœur de l’assaut du Capitole par les supporters les plus fanatiques de Donald Trump.
cast: Eric Swalwell, Jim McGovern, Ruben Gallego, Chuck Schumer, Dick Durbin

name: In the Mood for Love (2000)
plot: In 1962 Hong Kong, two neighbors form a strong bond after both suspect extramarital activities of their spouses.
cast: Tony Leung Chiu-Wai, Maggie Cheung Man-Yuk, Rebecca Pan, Kelly Lai Chen, Siu Ping-lam

name: Israël et le double assassinat des frères Kennedy (2019)
plot: Robert Kennedy était assassiné alors qu’il venait de gagner les primaires de Californie, ce qui faisait de lui le favori dans la course présidentielle. Une fois à la Maison-Blanche, il aurait été en mesure de rouvrir l’enquête sur la mort de son frère 5 ans plus tôt, et l’on sait, par de nombreux témoignages, qu’il en avait l’intention. Ni l’assassinat de John ni celui de Robert ne sont élucidés. Le 22 novembre 1963, John Fitzgerald Kennedy était assassiné à Dallas. À l’occasion des 56 ans de sa disparition, ERTV vous propose un documentaire passionnant et extrêmement subversif d’une durée de 1 heure et 17 minutes réalisé à partir des travaux et avec la participation de Laurent Guyénot.

name: Istanbul tremble : La prévention du risque sismique (2020)
plot: La menace d′un tremblement de terre plane sur Istanbul, situé sur l′une des zones sismiques les plus actives de la planète. Au large de la mégalopole, déjà frappée en 1999, le blocage des plaques eurasiatique et anatolienne en mer de Marmara pourrait entraîner un séisme majeur dans les prochaines années. Ce risque pour les 15 millions d′habitants met les ingénieurs et les géologues face à un défi colossal.
cast: Stephan Lee Benson

name: Itinéraire d′un enfant placé (2017)
plot: Yanie a 14 ans et la famille d’accueil qui l’a élevé prend sa retraite. Les services sociaux estiment que sa mère, en réinsertion après une peine de prison, ne peut pas encore le récupérer. Yanie va donc débarquer dans une nouvelle famille, avec le risque, si ça ne colle pas, de se retrouver en foyer. C’est une épreuve ajoutée à toutes les autres, une chance aussi peut-être de rompre avec les vieux modèles qui encombrent sa vie. Le film tente de saisir ce moment qu’on appelle résilience. Dans le fracas de son existence, Yanie va développer des mécanismes de défense.

name: J′aime pas Just Riadh (2021)
cast: Riadh Belaïche

name: Jane par Charlotte (2022)
plot: Charlotte Gainsbourg a commencé à filmer sa mère, Jane Birkin, pour la regarder comme elle ne l’avait jamais fait. La pudeur de l’une face à l’autre n’avait jamais permis un tel rapprochement. Mais par l’entremise de la caméra, la glace se brise pour faire émerger un échange inédit, sur plusieurs années, qui efface peu à peu les deux artistes et les met à nu dans une conversation intime inédite et universelle pour laisser apparaître une mère face à une fille. Jane par Charlotte.
cast: Jane Birkin, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Jo Attal, Iggy Pop, Serge Gainsbourg

name: Jason X (2001)
plot: In the year 2455, Old Earth is now a contaminated planet abandoned for centuries -- a brown world of violent storms, toxic landmasses and poisonous seas. Yet humans have returned to the deadly place that they once fled, not to live, but to research the ancient, rusting artifacts of the long-gone civilizations. But it′s not the harmful environment that could prove fatal to the intrepid, young explorers who have just landed on Old Earth. For them, it′s Friday the 13th, and Jason lives!
cast: Kane Hodder, Jeff Geddis, Lexa Doig, David Cronenberg, Markus Parilo

name: Jeff Bezos : Objectif tourisme spatial (2021)
plot: Les coulisses du vol spatial de l′entrepreneur milliardaire Jeff Bezos, du développement de la technologie au premier vol habité de la fusée Blue Origin.
cast: Chris Jacobs, Christian Davenport

name: Jesus Camp
plot: Jesus Camp is a Christian summer camp where children hone their \\\"prophetic gifts\\\" and are schooled in how to \\\"take back America for Christ\\\". The film is a first-ever look into an intense training ground that recruits born-again Christian children to become an active part of America′s political future.
cast: Becky Fischer, Mike Papantonio, Ted Haggard, Lou Engle

name: Jeunesse à vendre (2018)
plot: Le film suit les parcours heurtés d’Océane, Léa et Inès. À peine entrées dans l’adolescence, elles font de constants aller et retour entre leurs chambres d’enfants… et leurs chambres d’hôtel.  Comment expliquer ces passages à l’acte ? Flics, éducateurs, psys : tous les acteurs de terrain pointent l’invasion des codes du porno et la vitesse de propagation du numérique.

name: Jimi Hendrix : Electric Church (2015)
plot: Jimi Hendrix Electric Church (titre provenant d′une expression de Hendrix pour désigner la musique qui parle directement à l′âme). Deux mois avant sa mort à Londres en 1970, le 4 juillet Jimi Hendrix enflammait la scène de l′Atlanta Pop Festival, une manifestation plus grande que Woodstock. Ce jour-là, le guitariste se produisait devant plus de 300 000 spectateurs, faisant de ce concert son plus important en terme d’audience sur le territoire américain. Un festival d′images inédites à découvrir.
cast: Jimi Hendrix, Billy Cox, Mitch Mitchell, Eddie Kramer

name: Jimmy Carter : Le Président rock′n′roll (2020)
plot: Soutenu par des pop stars lors de sa campagne de 1976, Jimmy Carter se distingue des autres présidents des États-Unis par sa passion pour la musique.
cast: Jimmy Carter, Bob Dylan, Willie Nelson, Madeleine Albright, Garth Brooks

name: Jodie Foster, Hollywood dans la peau (2021)
plot: De son statut de sex-symbol précoce à sa consécration comme cinéaste, l′histoire de Jodie Foster est celle d′un combat féministe atypique, disputé en sous-main sur l′écran et en dehors. Ce film se propose de retracer cette trajectoire hors-norme au sein de l′industrie d′Hollywood.
cast: Jodie Foster, B. Ruby Rich, Jordan Mintzer, Jonathan Demme, Claude Chabrol

name: John Ford : l′homme qui inventa l′Amérique (2019)
plot: De « La Prisonnière du désert » aux « Raisins de la colère », John Ford a contribué à bâtir la légende américaine. Avec pour fils rouges la Monument Valley qu′il immortalisa de si belle manière et le silence farouche qu′il opposait aux intervieweurs, un portrait à la mesure du géant du cinéma américain.
cast: Jean-Christophe Klotz, Joseph McBride, Cécile Gornet, Michel Cieutat, Jennifer Ortiz

name: Kipchoge : l′ultime défi (2021)
plot: Portrait d′Eliud Kipchoge, le détenteur du record du monde de marathon. De ses terrains d′entraînement au Kenya aux installations de hautes technologies en Europe, découverte du parcours d′un athlète hors-norme jusqu′à sa tentative de record à Vienne, en octobre 2019.
cast: Eliud Kipchoge, Patrick Sang

name: Klitschko (2011)
plot: Klitschko tells the captivating story of the boxing worlds most famous brothers: Vitali and Wladimir Klitschko. From the socialist drill of their childhood in the Ukraine, and their first successes as amateurs, to their move to Germany and subsequent rise as international stars on the verge of holding the championship titles of all five boxing federations (Wladimir secured this with his unanimous World Boxing Association win against David Haye on July 2nd, 2011). Along the way they experience defeats and setbacks, low points and triumphant comebacks as well as conflicts with each other. Exciting conversations with companions and opponents, including the very first with the Klitschkos parents, give insight into their personal lives, plus never-before-seen footage of the draining preparations for a fight, and the spectacular boxing matches. Director Sebastian Dehnhardt composes an intimate and fascinating portrait of two exceptional athletes who are, before all else, brothers.
cast: Vitali Klitschko, Wladimir Klitschko, Nadeshda Uljanowna Klitschko, Hayden Panettiere, Natalia Yegorova

name: Krill : le secret de la banquise (2015)
plot: Clé de voûte de l′écosystème en Antarctique, le krill, petite crevette de la taille d′un doigt, voit sa population dangereusement décliner. Afin de percer le mystère de cette inquiétante disparition, une équipe de scientifiques lance une expédition inédite en plein hiver austral. Un documentaire édifiant enrichi par de somptueuses images prises sous la glace.

name: Kriss Kyle′s Kaleidoscope (2015)
plot: Dans le film Kaleidoscope, le rider BMX Kriss Kyle enchaîne les world first dans un décor géométrique de science fiction.

name: Kurt Cobain: Montage of Heck (2015)
plot: Une plongée dans l’intimité et l’esprit de Kurt Cobain, du groupe Nirvana. Salué comme étant le plus intime et le plus innovant documentaire jamais réalisé sur le chanteur, le film est une plongée cinématographique viscérale dans sa vie. De la jeunesse de Kurt à Aberdeen, sa ville natale, jusqu′au sommet de sa gloire, le réalisateur Brett Morgen opère un savant mélange d’extraits et d′archives inédites de l′artiste (dessins, musiques et vidéos de famille), ainsi que des interviews jamais dévoilées de sa famille et de ses plus proches confidents.
cast: Kurt Cobain, Courtney Love, Krist Novoselic, Dave Grohl, Frances Bean Cobain

name: Donetsk, la bataille de l’Ukraine (2017)
plot: Du printemps 2014 à l’été 2015, Anthony Butts a filmé la sécession en Ukraine de la République autoproclamée de Donetsk et sa lente dérive vers la guerre, au plus près d’une poignée de combattants et d’activistes de la première heure. En suivant leur révolte contre le gouvernement intérimaire de Kiev, issu du mouvement de « Maïdan », son film montre combien, pour la majorité des russophones du Donbass, bassin industriel en déshérence, la chute de l’URSS reste synonyme de pauvreté et d’humiliation.

name: La cité médiévale de Rocamadour (2020)
plot: Une époustouflante citadelle médiévale, bâtie à flanc de falaise, aux confins du Massif Central. Ce sanctuaire XXL bâti en équilibre sur la roche, s´étend sur 364 mètres de hauteur, soit 40 mètres de plus que la Tour Eiffel. La cité médiévale de Rocamadour doit aussi sa renommée au fabuleux trésor qu´elle renferme. 9 siècles après sa fondation, nous vous révélons les secrets d´une géante de la foi, entre prouesses techniques hors-normes et histoire de légende.

name: La cité perdue d′Al Andalus
plot: Au Xe siècle le calife Abd al Rahman III décide de restaurer, en Espagne, la puissance de ses ancêtres omeyyades qui régnaient en Orient quelques siècles plus tôt. Il ordonne de bâtir une cité colossale pour montrer à tous son pouvoir. La réputation de cette ville et sa richesse s′étend alors d′Occident en Orient. Cette civilisation raffinée imprègne encore aujourd′hui la culture européenne. Surnommée la \\\"Versailles d′al-Andalus\\\", Madinat al-Zahra est considérée aujourd′hui comme l′un des plus importants sites archéologiques islamique au monde.

name: La clef des champs (2014)
plot: Fred Bonnemaison, a driven and self-centered Parisian food writer has to return to his home town, Lyon, when his mother, a lively octogenarian, runs away to join a community of free-thinking widows.
cast: François Berléand, Florence Pernel, Isabelle Sadoyan, Rémy Adriaens, Nicole Biondi

name: La course en or des Gentlemen Drivers
Claudia Cardinale, la créature du secret (2019)
plot: How a young and wild tomboy Tunisian girl became a great actress by accident. Claudia Cardinale : the fanciful destiny of a paradoxical movie star, who appeared in Federico Fellini′s, Luchino Visconti′s, Blake Edwards′ and Sergio Leone′s films.
cast: Claudia Cardinale

name: La Haine (1995)
plot: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.
cast: Vincent Cassel, Hubert Koundé, Saïd Taghmaoui, Abdel Ahmed Ghili, Solo

name: La Fille de l′assassin (2023)
cast: Chloé Chaudoye, Bruno Wolkowitch, Nicolas Gob, Barbara Probst, Samir Boitard

La Génération Salut les copains (2019)
cast: Alain Chamfort, Christophe, Julien Clerc, Dani, Dave

name: LAllemagne à lheure de la RAF
La loi du silence (2003)
cast: René Vautier, Pierre Vidal-Naquet, Henri Alleg

name: La Légende (1993)
plot: A young girl sees the theater in which her parents play burn down, and they disappear in the fire. Twenty years later, the orphan girl, who has become an actress, is summoned by a director who wants to remount the play and offers her the role of her mother on condition that she finds the text. Immediately, and as if by magic, the father, like the ghost of the opera, reappears and dictates his conditions for access.
cast: Jean Yanne, Nathalie Grauwin, Rémi Martin, Yann Collette, Ann-Gisel Glass

name: La Magie de Noël à Disneyland  Les Plus Grands Secrets Enfin Révélés
La maison de lhorreur  le silence des agneaux en vrai
La Namibie  histoire dune colonie allemande
Lappel du cristal - Le making-of de Dark Crystal  Le temps de la résistance
La pénicilline  une révolution de la médecine
L′Arabe dans le poste
plot: On the occasion of the 40th anniversary of the "Marche des Beurs," this original documentary explores the evolution of the representation of French people of North African descent on television. A bold and humorous film, free of taboos, both thoughtful and optimistic.
cast: Melha Bedia, Rachida Dati, Ramzy Bedia, Rachid Arhab, Morald Chibout

name: Deneuve, la reine Catherine (2022)
plot: She is said to be cold, secretive and mysterious. She has the reputation of not letting anything of her intimate thoughts, her private life, her joys as well as her torments show through. She managed to protect her family, her loves, her choices from the curiosity of magazines and her public. A tour de force for a sixty year long career with more than one hundred and thirty films shot with the greatest filmmakers in the world. However, the raw material for a very personal account of Catherine Deneuve exists: it can be found in the interviews given by the actress from her beginnings until today. They allow us to discover another Catherine Deneuve.
cast: Catherine Deneuve, Chloé Réjon

name: Goebbels and the Führer (2024)
plot: As Minister of Propaganda, Joseph Goebbels creates films and pictures used to prepare the Germans for Total War and the Holocaust. When the war is lost, he conceives his last staging, the most radical propaganda act still possible to him.
cast: Robert Stadlober, Fritz Karl, Franziska Weisz, Sascha Göpel, Katia Fellin

name: Laura Laune : La victoire de l′audace (2021)
cast: Laura Laune, Guillaume Bats, Jérémy Ferrari, Kody Kim, Éric Antoine

name: Lautre rêve de Martin Luther King
La vie des frères Grimm - Au-delà des contes
La vie est belle  les héros de lombre de Mandela
The Family
plot: After ratting out his Mafia cohorts, Giovanni Manzoni and his family enter the Witness Protection Program and relocate to a sleepy town in France. Despite the best efforts of their handler to keep them in line, Giovanni (now called Fred Blake), his wife and children can′t help but resort to doing things the \\\"family\\\" way. However, their dependence on such old habits places everyone in danger from vengeful mobsters.
cast: Robert De Niro, Michelle Pfeiffer, Tommy Lee Jones, Dianna Agron, John D′Leo

name: L′Eau à paris : un défi technologique (2017)
Le Brésil et le cas Lula da Silva
Hitler-Staline, le choc des tyrans
plot: On 23 August 1939, the world was shocked to discover that Hitler and Stalin, the most intractable of their enemies at the time, had signed a pact that allowed them to divide Poland between them and gave the Nazi leader complete freedom to concentrate his forces in the West, against France and the United Kingdom. Through this agreement, Europe was to be thrown into war. For a long time, the relationship between Hitler and Stalin was ignored: their mutual fascination, their moves to get closer, the marks of confidence they exchanged and all the benefits they derived from the German-Soviet pact, before resuming their war to the death in June 41 with the \\\"Barbarossa\\\" operation.

name: le combat pour les droits de lhomme
Longest Third Date (2023)
plot: When Khani and Matt met on a dating app, they had no idea COVID-19 would turn their spur-of-the-moment trip to Costa Rica into a months-long adventure.
cast: Matt Robertson, Khani Le

name: Stalin′s Last Plot
plot: January 1953: On the eve of his death Stalin finds himself yet another imaginary enemy: Jewish doctors. He organizes the most violent anti-Semitic campaign ever launched in the USSR, by fabricating the \\\"Doctors′ Plot,\\\" whereby doctors are charged with conspiring to murder the highest dignitaries of the Soviet Regime. Still unknown and untold, this conspiracy underlines the climax of a political scheme successfully masterminded by Stalin to turn the Jews into the new enemies of the people. It reveals his extreme paranoia and his compulsion to manipulate those around him. The children and friends of the main victims recount for the first time their experience and their distress related to these nightmarish events.
cast: Patrick Floersheim, Jonathan Brent, Joseph Stalin, Vyacheslav Molotov, Natalya Rapoport

name: France, le fabuleux voyage (2021)
plot: Rather than learning France′s history through its people, we explore its natural history. A two billion-year journey back in time to look at the country′s geological heritage: a mountain chain becomes Brittany, lagoons where Paris now stands, ice from the Aiguille du Midi maps the routes of rivers flowing seawards.
cast: Philippe Torreton

name: Le Harem du Pharaon-Soleil (2017)
cast: Paul Harry Allen

name: Le Masque de fer : Le Secret enfin révélé (2021)
The Silent World (1956)
plot: Join renowned explorer Jacques-Yves Cousteau as he investigates aquatic habitats worldwide, showcasing whales, sharks, and diverse marine life. The film highlights the brutal realities of nature while capturing the wonder of underwater exploration, as the team ventures into previously unseen ocean depths.
cast: Jacques-Yves Cousteau

name: Le monde selon Radiohead
plot: With their hit song \\\"Creep\\\" Radiohead had their international breakthrough in the early nineties. They were first dismissed as a \\\"nerd band\\\" but since then have succeeded in redefining their style with each subsequent album. This documentary focuses on the band′s conflicting relationship between immense popularity and artistic integrity.

name: Le mystère de la Sagrada Família
Le Passeur de la Nahanni
plot: Four young climbers dream of climbing the Lotus Flower Tower, a legendary big wall, somewhere in the Cirque of the Unclimbables in the furthest outreaches of Northern Canada. For 800 m of climbing, they will have to face 550 km of dangerous Nahanni river over a whole month of total independence
cast: Dominique Snyers

name: Le pays qui n′aimait pas les femmes (2013)
Making Of (2024)
plot: Simon, a well-known French filmmaker, starts shooting his next film. A story about workers fighting to protect their factory from being relocated. But nothing goes as planned... His producer Viviane wants to rewrite the ending and is threatening to cut the budget; his own crew goes on strike; his personal life is in shambles; and to make things worse, his lead actor Alain is an egocentric jerk. Joseph, an extra who wants to get into the film industry, agrees to direct the making of and shoot the behind-the-scenes. He takes his role very seriously and starts following around the crew, capturing all this mess... What follows is proof that the making of can sometimes be far better than the film itself!
cast: Denis Podalydès, Jonathan Cohen, Stefan Crepon, Souheila Yacoub, Emmanuelle Bercot

name: Le peuple miniature
cast: Cécile de France, Stephen Fry

name: Les Pionniers (2017)
cast: Lounes Belaïdi, Camille Loubens, Jonathan Cohen

Le Puy du Fou raconté par Philippe de Villiers (2022)
cast: Philippe de Villiers

Les beaux perdants (2022)
cast: Hervé Mathoux, Michel Platini, Marius Trésor, Alain Giresse, Patrick Battiston

name: Der große Fake - Die Wirecard-Story (2021)
cast: Christoph Maria Herbst, Franz Hartwig, Nina Kunzendorf, Alexander Altomirianos, Lisa Hrdina

name: On the Inside of a Military Dictatorship (2019)
plot: The entire world praised the military and Aung San Suu Kyi, when power was passed on to the democracy icon after 50 years of military dictatorship. One year later she defended an ethnic cleansing and had isolated herself from the public. This film tells you why.

name: Les dessous de la statue de la Liberté
Children of Las Brisas (2022)
plot: In Venezuela, amidst a backdrop of poverty, murder, and corruption, the El Sistema youth orchestra offers children hope and the opportunity to pursue a life of art in spite of the harshness of the society around them. Yet the country’s spiraling collapse and political repression threatens the musicians’ dreams of a better life.
cast: Edixon Yánez, Dissandra Viloria, Wuilly Moisés Arteaga, Alexandra Morales, Dissaimy Viloria

name: Les grandes heures de lautomobile allemande
Les grandes heures de lautomobile Peugeot
Les grands singes Ces primates si proches de lhomme
Les  Nouveaux Soldats de la Chine
Les Plus Grandes Places de Paris
les vestiges de la Rome gauloise
Overdosed (2021)
plot: Interviews with former drug dealers, over-prescribing doctors and DEA agents uncover a shocking truth of the pharmaceutical industry’s plan to target opioid sales to an impoverished community.

name: Lettre au Baïkal
cast: Julie Moniere

name: Indestructible (2008)
plot: Indestructible portrays an epic journey of self-discovery for filmmaker and single father Ben Byer as he battles the incurable and fatal neuro-degenerative disease, ALS (aka Lou Gehrig′s disease), chronicles his search for an effective treatment in this poignant Cinequest Film Festival award winner for Best Documentary. Byer records his emotional and spiritual highs and lows and celebrates life as he journeys across the United States, to Greece and to China, where his hope teeters on an experimental operation.
cast: Ben Byer

name: L′ordre à tout prix
plot: When France rumbles, the strategy and control of public order become a crucial political issue. Between protecting institutions and guaranteeing the right to demonstrate: the right balance is subtle. At the beginning of the Yellow Vests movement, at the end of 2018, the principles of \\\"French-style\\\" policing were shattered. The ransacking of the Arc Triomphe, the hundreds of injuries among the demonstrators and the forces of order mark the minds. How did it come to this? In order to understand, the film questions the so-called \\\"legitimate\\\" force and confronts them with the images of these confrontations.

name: Lynx (2021)
plot: In the heart of the Jura mountains, a call resounds through the forest. The silhouette of a Eurasian lynx creeps through the trees. A male is looking for its mate. Suddenly a call answers back. It is the beginning of the story of a lynx’s family we will follow over the seasons. While it is rare to come across this private feline, it is exceptional to discover its daily life in the wild.
cast: Laurent Geslin

name: LÉcole de la vie - Une génération pour tout changer
L′Éveil de la Permaculture (2017)
cast: Cécile Arnaud

name: Mariupolis (2016)
plot: The city of Mariupolis is by the Azov sea. It is also on the river Kalmius. Most of the city’s residents, half a million according to the last census, are working for the steel factory and do fishing, for leisure or food, in between shifts. The orthodox church towers above the city and its newly build bronze domes are sitting next to it, waiting to be donned. A tent near by is sheltering a crying icon, which receives a steady flow of visitors.

name: Mariupolis 2 (2022)
plot: In 2022, Mantas Kvedaravičius went back to Ukraine, Mariupol, at the heart of the war, to be with the people he had met and filmed in 2015. Following his death, his producers and collaborators have put all their strength into continuing transmitting his work, his vision and his films. Also a PhD in anthropology, Mantas Kvedaravičius wished to testify as a filmmaker as far as possible from the agitation of the media and the politicians. With huge force and sensitivity, Mariupolis 2 depicts life as it continues amidst the bombing and reveals images that convey both tragedy and hope.

name: McEnroe
plot: Legendary \\\"bad boy of tennis\\\" John McEnroe finally tells his side of his storied career and famously hot-tempered performances on the court in this engrossing documentary revisiting the record-setting career of one of the all-time greats.
cast: John McEnroe, Patty Smyth, Kevin McEnroe, Emily McEnroe, Ruby Smyth Meyers-McEnroe

Mister George  lextraordinaire vie de George Eddy
Mon héros (2014)

cast: Guillaume Viry, Damien Bonnard, Estéban, Christophe Tek

name: Moonage Daydream (2022)
plot: A cinematic odyssey featuring never-before-seen footage exploring David Bowie′s creative and musical journey.
cast: David Bowie, Lou Reed, Tina Turner, Russell Harty, Dick Cavett

name: Musher, l′appel de l′Alaska (2023)
cast: Pierre de Parscau, Sébastien dos Santos Borges

name: National Geographic  A la recherche de larche de Noé
Inside Mecca (2003)
plot: The events of the hajj have long remained veiled from non-Muslims, who are forbidden even to enter the holy city of Mecca. A team of Muslim filmmakers gained access to Islam′s holiest place at the peak of the pilgrimage to document the holy event for National Geographic Television.
cast: Keith David

name: National Geographic  Dans la peau dun ours
National Geographic  La jeune fille afghane
National Geographic  La vérité sur Toutankhamon
National Geographic  Le Langage des Géants dEtosha
National Geographic  Le Mystère des momies incas

Tigers of the Snow (1997)
plot: There are only about 300 remaining Siberian Tigers in the wild, restricted to a section of far Eastern Russia, near the coast. Wildlife biologists risk life and limb to track the tiger and research its movements and habits. They sedate the animals so the tigers can be measured and collared. One Russian scientist is shown raising two tigers which he found orphaned as cubs. He keeps the tigers in a cage, then allows the beasts into a fenced forest-like enclosure. The efforts of these scientists are in contrast to those of poachers, who kill the tigers for their pelts, as well as for body parts to be marketed in traditional Chinese medicine.
cast: Richard Kiley

name: neuf mois dans la vie dAmel Majri
So Help Me God (2018)
plot: Some 20 years ago, two sex workers were murdered in an upper-class Brussels neighborhood. Celebrated Belgian magistrate Anne Gurwez decides to revisit this cold case, pouring over the evidence with the use of new technologies and tracking down then-suspects.
cast: Anne Gruwez, David Derumier, Serge Graide, Marc Slavic, Eddy Wilmet

name: Nous paysans (2021)
plot: In barely a century, French peasants have seen their world profoundly turned upside down. While they once made up the vast majority of the country, today they are only a tiny minority and are faced with an immense challenge: to continue to feed France. From the figure of the simple tenant farmer described by Emile Guillaumin at the beginning of the 20th century to the heavy toll paid by peasants during the Great War, from the beginnings of mechanization in the inter-war period to the ambivalent figure of the peasant under the Occupation, From the unbridled race to industrialization in post-war France to the realization that it is now necessary to rethink the agricultural model and invent the agriculture of tomorrow, the film looks back at the long march of French peasants.
cast: Guillaume Canet

name: Opération Peter Pan - Lexode des enfants cubains
The Red Balloon (1956)
plot: A young boy discovers a stray balloon, which seems to have a mind of its own, on the streets of Paris. The two become inseparable, yet the world’s harsh realities finally interfere.
